cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# answer range B2:H6
# For each row i in 1..5, columns B..H
# B = Question i, C = Option A i, D = Option B i, E = Option C i, F = Option D i, G = Answer i, H = Explanation i
for i in range(1,6):
    ws.cell(2+i,2).value = f'=A{2+i-1}'
    ws.cell(2+i,3).value = f'=A{2+i-1+1}'
    ws.cell(2+i,4).value = f'=A{2+i-1+2}'
    ws.cell(2+i,5).value = f'=A{2+i-1+3}'
    ws.cell(2+i,6).value = f'=A{2+i-1+4}'
    ws.cell(2+i,7).value = f'=A{2+i-1+5}'
    ws.cell(2+i,8).value = f'=A{2+i-1+6}'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
